action.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 120 yarn dev >/tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &
sleep 90
echo "===dev log tail==="; tail -30 /tmp/dev.log
echo "===curl 3000==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/ ; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>'
